cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. We split the bill exactly. Now toss for who apologises to the waiter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Otherwise this dinner ends without a distinction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then least enthusiastic enjoyment pays the tip. Rate yours carefully.

mechanism: A turns an equal restaurant bill into a formal verbal tiebreaker while treating B enjoyment as material for a former etiquette lesson.
confusable: Not simple payment haggling: A cannot leave equality intact and invents a measurable losing condition with the tip as penalty.
comparison: Kitchen skill tie versus equal spending and equal enjoyment.
